purpose: Focused native-only Prometheus-parity validation corpus for classic histogram quantile support over grouped/rate-fed bucket inputs.
notes: Exercises histogram_quantile on canonical grouped/rate-fed classic histogram bucket inputs.
Uses baseline and histogram_burst dataset variants to catch bucket-shape regressions.

histogram_quantile_grouped_absent_label_staggered_instant pins the issue #38 regression: an instant quantile over sum by(le, <label absent on the bucket series>) must coalesce buckets from series with staggered last-sample times (resets_gaps variant) into one histogram per group instead of fragmenting by per-series timestamp on the fused direct path. Its timeOffsetSeconds of 480 assumes the default seed parameters (PROM_HARNESS_STEP_SECONDS=60, PROM_HARNESS_POINTS=10) so the evaluation lands on a resets_gaps gap point for job=api,instance=a; with non-default seeding the case still runs but loses the staggered-timestamp signal.

Other classic-histogram helper functions added in native SQL are currently covered by unit/native-renderer tests; Prometheus result parity over those classic bucket-only shapes is not yet used as a harness gate here.
